`GET /invoices/<id>` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I couldn't run it: Flask isn't installed in this environment, so my quick test failed at the import.

In `src/api/invoices.py`, if the ID isn't found, the route returns `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", "No invoice with id '<id>'")`. That's the project's existing error helper, so the response matches the other API errors (`application/problem+json`, with `type`, `title`, `status` and `detail`). Before this change, a missing ID crashed on `None.__dict__` and gave a 500.

Once Flask is installed, you can check it by calling `GET /invoices/nope` on the app's test client and confirming you get a 404 with the error body.
